pages.text: One legendary weapon per meteor, made from its boss's drops. Each has its own effect.
pages.title: Legendary Weapons

pages.text: Swamp. Fast, and each hit launches the target 2 blocks up (4 s cooldown, not bosses).
pages.title: Glasswing Scythe

pages.text: Hive. Slow and crushing, and it heals you for 10% of the damage it deals.
pages.title: Royal Grandhammer

pages.text: Desert. Four blades. Hits slow the target by 10% for 3 s.
pages.title: Quadblade of the Sands

pages.text: Rainforest. The fastest. Hits stack Bleeding: 1 damage a second per stack, up to 3.
pages.title: Serrated Longsword
